english.notes:
(i) For the purpose of the offence, a person can access, enter, inspect, pass over/under, approach or, be in the vicinity of a prohibited place by electronic or remote means, see section 5(4).
(ii) Unlike the offence under section 4, there is no requirement under this offence for the person to have, or, be acting with a purpose prejudicial to the safety or interests of the United Kingdom. This ensures action can be taken in cases where a person is knowingly carrying out unauthorised conduct, such as trespassing, at a prohibited place.
(iii) For offending under this section committed via an unmanned vehicle or device, see H101398.

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and / or fine.

Section 5 of the National Security Act 2023 provides that the penalty for this offence is the maximum term for summary offences. In relation to an offence committed before the time when section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 comes into force, the 'maximum term' is 6 months and in relation to an offence committed after that time, is 51 weeks.

Time limit for prosecutions:6 months
